evidence: A large slip in Dart Valley between Daleys Flat Hut and Chinamans Bluff has made the Rees-Dart Track circuit impassable for trampers.
Option 3: Helicopter transfer with Heli Glenorchy over the affected section of track (Top of Dredge Flat to Surveyors Flat – one hour walk from Chinamans Bluff).
The Rees track begins 68 km from Queenstown, via Glenorchy, and there is a car park at Muddy Creek.
The Dart track begins 76 km from Queenstown via Glenorchy. A 2WD road extends to Chinamans Bluff, however, this is a fine weather road only and subject to washouts and flooded creeks.

evidence: Option 1: Walk from Muddy Creek to Dart Hut and back out the same way (just Rees Valley)
Take the vehicle track from Muddy Creek and follow the marker poles across the boggy section beyond Arthurs Creek.
The Dart Hut is on Snowy Creek's true left and can be reached via a swing bridge.

evidence: Option 2: Walk over Cascade Saddle to Dart Hut and out along Rees Valley
The route to both the Dart and Rees valleys veers off to the left, just before you reach Cascade Saddle.
Slightly upstream from the confluence of the Dart and Snowy Creek, a bridge over the creek leads to Dart Hut.

doubts: The Dart Track is closed indefinitely by a slip between Daleys Flat Hut and Chinamans Bluff; the page offers three options and describes only the Rees Valley (Muddy Creek to Dart Hut) and Cascade Saddle to Dart Hut sections in detail. I recorded the full track (DOC's 4-5 days / 63 km one way, Option 3 with a helicopter over Dredge Flat to Surveyors Flat) as the main way, but its course down the Dart valley (Dart Hut to Daleys Flat Hut to Chinamans Bluff) and its end at Chinamans Bluff are pieced together from the closure notice and Getting there, not from a described route; the page calls it a 'circuit' while DOC says one way. Muddy Creek is given as T23 (the creek) since the car park is 'at Muddy Creek' and there is no road end feature. Option 2's start is near Cascade Saddle, reached by another route the page does not describe; its 4-5 hr / 10 km covers only Cascade Saddle to Dart Hut, so no time or distance was given for the whole option. Option 1's section times are given per section only. The Kea Basin side trip leaves from across the Rees River north of Lennox Falls; no exact place on the way is named.
